meta.notes: Parsed from each cantrip's Cantrip Upgrade text in SRD 5.2. Typical damage cantrips scale at character levels 5, 11, and 17.

records.name: Acid Splash
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

records.name: Chill Touch
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

records.name: Eldritch Blast
records.upgradeText: The spell creates two beams at level 5, three beams at level 11, and four beams at level 17. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

records.name: Fire Bolt
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

records.name: Poison Spray
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d12 when you reach levels 5 (2d12), 11 (3d12), and 17 (4d12).

records.name: Produce Flame
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

records.name: Ray of Frost
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

records.name: Sacred Flame
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

records.name: Shillelagh
records.upgradeText: The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d10), 11 (d12), and 17 (2d6).

records.name: Shocking Grasp
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

records.name: Sorcerous Burst
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

records.name: Spare the Dying
records.upgradeText: The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).

records.name: Starry Wisp
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

records.name: True Strike
records.upgradeText: Whether you deal Radiant damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Radiant damage when you reach levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).

records.name: Vicious Mockery
records.upgradeText: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).
